entries.supportDesc:
View more / expand row — each row has a "▼ More" button on the right. Clicking it expands an inline panel below that row with a grey background (#F2F6FA), showing all the detail fields: full description, CO focal point, actual hours, surge, support provided, outcome, more CO requests, survey sent, survey results, last updated, updated by. Clicking "▲ Less" collapses it. Only one row can be expanded at a time.
Edit modal — clicking "Edit" opens the same modal but pre-filled, with the delivery fields (grey section) visible. A "Delete entry" button appears only in edit mode. The modal is clean and properly grid-aligned — two-column for short fields, full-width for textareas, clear section labels, consistent border and spacing.
